note: Frames are 60 fps from the effect's start. It fires at the press, 0.5 s before the hit, so a tell carries Cleave's wind-up; the hit is f30 and the recovery ends f78.
story: A heavy two-handed slam. As Cleave winds up, a gold ring tightens on the ground under the blade and motes rise toward it: the ground gathering itself. At the hit everything compresses into one white frame on the impact point, then the ground answers: floor streaks race out, a cone of air is thrown up, rocks and shards burst out and fall, and a hand-drawn blast flares. Then it settles: thin smoke spreads out, slows and thins away, the dust ring widens and fades, and a few embers drift long after the swing has recovered.
